result.summary: The page is generally well-structured, but two visual/content issues stand out: a restaurant name is truncated in the horizontal list, and the bottom restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section is partially cut off.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' horizontal list, the restaurant name is displayed as 'Trattoria Piccol', which appears truncated and does not show the full name.
issues.suggestion: Allow longer restaurant names to wrap to a second line, widen the card, or use ellipsis with a tooltip so users can read the complete name.

issues.description: The last visible card in the 'Popular right now' section is cut off at the bottom of the screen. Only the image and '-20%' badge are visible; the restaurant name, rating, and delivery information are hidden.
issues.suggestion: Add adequate bottom padding to the scrollable content area or adjust the viewport layout so the last card is fully visible above the bottom navigation bar.
